# Glostrup: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge

Glostrup: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge is a child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinic operating under [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] in Denmark, also referred to in later reporting as "Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge, Glostrup, B29" and as part of the "Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center Glostrup" [^src10]. The clinic appears repeatedly as a reporting unit in Denmark's national ADHD quality database (ADHD-databasen), which tracks how well child and adolescent psychiatric departments across the country meet clinical quality indicators for ADHD assessment and treatment.

In the ADHD database's 2023 annual report, covering the period 01.04.2023–31.03.2024, Glostrup: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge opnåede 19 % opfyldelse af Indikator 3 blandt 1.221 udredningsforløb [^src3] — measuring whether diagnostic conferences were held within 120 days of the start of assessment — with 232 of 1,221 pathways meeting the standard (95 % CI: 17–21) [^src3]. This placed the clinic well below the database's national development target of 90 %. The same report shows the clinic reporting 747 of 1,221 pathways (61 %) with completed somatic assessment [^src12], and separately recorded 74 of 123 pathways (60 %, 95 % CI 51–69) against another indicator, with 0 % (0) noted for a related sub-measure [^src13]. For Indicator 4, concerning coordinating network meetings within 90 days of treatment start, Glostrup havde 55 % opfyldelse af indikator 4 (95% CI: 49-61) med 144 forløb ud af 261 [^src1], and elsewhere 49 % (95 % CI 43–56) based on 129 of 261 pathways [^src2].

By the time of the 2024 annual report, covering 01.04.2024–31.03.2025, the clinic (now consistently labelled "Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge, Glostrup, B29") shows a range of indicator results: 56 % (95 % CI 53–59) based on 581 of 1,031 pathways [^src4]; 21 % (95 % CI 18–23) based on 233 of 1,124 pathways [^src5]; 37 % (95 % CI 34–40) based on 347 of 947 pathways [^src6]; 34 % (95 % CI 31–37) based on 325 of 947 pathways [^src7]; and 68 % (95 % CI 64–71) based on 640 of 947 pathways, alongside a 0 % sub-value [^src7]. Smaller sub-populations were also reported: 0 out of 7 pathways (95 % CI 0–41) for one indicator [^src8], 4 out of 7 (57 %, 95 % CI 18–90) for another [^src9], and an unspecified fraction with 0 % (95 % CI 0–98) for a further measure [^src14]. In a summary table the clinic's figure of 57 appears listed alongside its name under the Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center Glostrup / Psykiatrisk Center Glostrup heading [^src10].

Across both reporting years, the clinic is consistently identified as located in, and organisationally part of, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] [^src1] [^src3] [^src6] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13]. It is one of many child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient departments tracked nationally, and its indicator results — most falling well short of the 90 % development target used throughout the database — mirror the broader pattern described in the source reports of a Danish child and adolescent psychiatric system under sustained pressure, with wide regional variation in ADHD assessment quality and treatment follow-through [^src1] [^src3].
